title: 12 Best Sip green tea and eat shashlik beside the ancient Lyabi-Hauz pool, once a caravan crossroads at the heart of the Silk Road city of Bukhara.
description: Discover the best spots to savor traditional green tea and succulent shashlik by Bukhara's iconic Lyabi-Hauz. Immerse yourself in Silk Road history with every bite and sip.
category: Sip green tea and eat shashlik beside the ancient Lyabi-Hauz pool, once a caravan crossroads at the heart

places.name: Chaykhana Lyabi Hauz
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Shashlik assorti (mixed skewers) with a pot of Kok Choy (green tea)

places.name: Old Bukhara Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Lamb shashlik and a pot of Black Tea with local sweets

places.name: Rustam & Zukhra Teahouse
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chicken shashlik with a variety of infused green teas (e.g., lemon-mint)

places.name: Labi Hovuz Chaikhana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Beef shashlik and a classic pot of Pialla Choy (black tea)

places.name: Doston House Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assorted shashlik skewers (lamb, beef, chicken) and a pot of Kukk Choy (green tea)

places.name: Mulla Kholiq Chaykhana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mix shashlik (liver and meat) and a large pot of traditional green tea

places.name: Café Wishbone
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Beef shashlik and an iced green tea (if you need a break from hot tea)

places.name: Chor Minor Restaurant & Tea House
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Lamb Kebab (shashlik) and a pot of green tea with local herbs

places.name: Samani Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mixed Grill Platter (includes various shashliks) and a pot of Jasmine Green Tea

places.name: Anor Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pomegranate-glazed Lamb Shashlik and their signature 'Anor Choy' (pomegranate tea)

places.name: Naqshband Garden Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegetable Shashlik (for non-meat eaters) or Mixed Lamb & Beef Shashlik, with a pot of refreshing green tea

places.name: Chaykhana Khonakoh
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Jigar Shashlik (liver shashlik, a local favorite) and a pot of pure Kok Choy
